result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions. The `codeanalyzer` module tests ran with no errors in the output tail. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `app.js`, `MyAssembly.xml` or `build-gradle.js` cases, and I didn't run them by hand.

**`GeneratedConventions.java`**
- The pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules now use `[.](html|htm|xhtml)`. The extension list was `html|html|xhtml`, with `html` repeated where `htm` was meant.
- The `<doc>` XML rule now matches `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`.
- The `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule now matches `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`.

**`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**
- The Gradle JavaScript rule now matches `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`.

I only widened the filename patterns, so everything that matched before (`.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle`) still matches. Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes because the content patterns still have to match too.
